cv_text: Firmware engineer with four years on STM32 and ESP32 in C. Wrote UART, I2C and SPI drivers, used FreeRTOS queues and a hardware watchdog, debugged timing with an oscilloscope. Git for everything.

Recent graduate, communication and computer engineering. Final-year project: bare-metal C on an STM32 reading a temperature sensor over I2C and logging over UART. NTI embedded systems course; Arduino since school.
Embedded C developer. Bootloader and OTA update work on ESP32, low-power deep-sleep designs, CAN bus on an automotive side project, KiCad for small boards. Comfortable with a logic analyser.
I write real-time code for microcontrollers. RTOS task design, interrupt handling, SPI displays, register-level peripheral setup from the datasheet, unit tests on the host with a C test runner.

IoT engineer at an agriculture startup. ESP32 nodes publishing MQTT over TLS to AWS IoT Core, X.509 provisioning, Linux gateways, Python tooling, Grafana dashboards. Field debugging of Wi-Fi dropouts.

Connected-devices developer: LoRaWAN sensor nodes, MQTT broker setup with Mosquitto, Node-RED flows, Modbus RTU polling of industrial meters, Python scripts for data collection, Docker on a Raspberry Pi.

Built a smart incubator: ESP32 firmware in C, sensors (SHT31), MQTT telemetry, Firebase realtime database, Flutter dashboard. Published the design in a journal paper. Python for analysing the telemetry.
Engineer who connects things to the cloud: BLE and Wi-Fi devices, certificate-based device identity, telemetry pipelines, Linux, Python and C. Experience keeping a fleet of 200 devices online.

Data analyst, three years in retail. SQL (PostgreSQL), Excel, Power BI dashboards, Python with pandas for cleaning exports, A/B test design and hypothesis testing. Present weekly to non-technical managers.

I turn messy operational data into reports: Excel, SQL, Python notebooks, plotly charts, basic statistics. Worked with finance and operations teams on monthly KPIs.

AI engineer working on NLP: transformers and LLM-based classifiers with PyTorch, evaluation sets, model deployment and monitoring, Python services, cloud deployment on AWS.

Python developer: Flask and FastAPI services, SQL databases, websockets for live updates, Kubernetes deployment, unit testing, agile team of six.
Software engineer, backend. Django, REST APIs, OpenAPI docs, SQL schema design and migrations, Docker Compose for local dev, AWS Lambda for small jobs, test-driven development.
API developer in Python. Built payment and notification services with FastAPI, GraphQL gateway, MongoDB and PostgreSQL, Redis queues, Git, pytest coverage above 90 percent.
